svg.title: F2: Data construction and cue-assisted annotation

g.text: (a) From conversations to audiovisual listening pairs
Aligned media → timestamped cues → ordered descriptions
Times guide annotation; the final description retains the order of reactions.
(c) Retained samples and derived training labels
Speaker audio · reference frame · listener A/V · caption
Resolve conflicting evidence; mask unknown categories.
All portraits, waveforms, cue intervals and example text are schematic placeholders.
